coverage_limits: I worked only from the 12 provided thirds, at their native resolution, with no further zoom. Consonants, vowels, punctuation, maqaf and rubrics I could confirm. Very small sub-linear marks (meteg vs. tipcha/merkha/munah) and a few dagesh dots I could not confirm one by one; those listed are unresolved, not certified. The English citations recorded on s111/s113 ('(Deut. VI. 4)', '(Deut. XI. 13)', '(Numbers XV. 37)') are on pages not in this scope and were not checked. Human-settled occurrences were taken as authoritative and I found no contrary evidence. Because of the unresolved items above, none of these pages should be marked accepted yet.
